term.ajuda:
openTARS {versao} — 100% local AI assistant

  opentars                          chat in the terminal
  opentars-gui                      opens the window
  opentars-gui --rapido             opens the quick bar
  opentars --idioma <code>          changes the language (pt_BR, en, es, fr, de...)
  opentars --atalho [keys|off]      shows, changes or removes the global shortcut
  opentars --diagnostico            checks the setup (Ollama, screen, accessibility...)
  opentars --autoteste              diagnostics + a real test with the calculator
  opentars --avaliar-classificador  measures the accuracy of the embeddings and the helper
  opentars --explicar "request"     shows, layer by layer, how the task and the model are chosen
  opentars --setup                  installs whatever is missing (Ollama, models...)
  opentars --version                shows the version
